name: Schedules due when they should be
purpose: Exactly the schedules that are due are named, over calendar periods in the schedule's own zone, requested runs and events.
record: Cases taken from the cadence, run-request and reactive-event cases a production autopilot's own tests assert (evaluation/proactivity/build_cases.py), one number: the share of cases with exactly the right schedules.
disadvantages: Eighteen cases from one production system's rules; a second system's schedules would widen it.
cascading_conditionals: free [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=the arm and its rivals were recorded on the same cases]
command: esoi run proactivity --impl calendar_and_events; esoi run proactivity --impl elapsed_hours
